auth.carQuote01: "Any customer can have a car painted any color that he wants so long as it is black." –Henry Ford
auth.carQuote02: "Aerodynamics are for people who can't build engines." –Enzo Ferrari
auth.carQuote03: "I couldn't find the sports car of my dreams, so I built it myself." –Ferdinand Porsche
auth.carQuote05: "If everything seems under control, you're just not going fast enough." –Mario Andretti
auth.carQuote06: "Horsepower sells cars, torque wins races." –Carroll Shelby
auth.carQuote07: "Racing is life. Anything before or after is just waiting." –Steve McQueen
auth.carQuote08: "Second place is just the first place loser." –Dale Earnhardt
auth.carQuote09: "Straight roads are for fast cars, turns are for fast drivers." –Colin McRae
auth.carQuote10: "If you no longer go for a gap, you are no longer a racing driver." –Ayrton Senna
auth.carQuote11: "The main thing is to finish. You cannot win if you don't finish." –Niki Lauda
auth.carQuote12: "Leave me alone, I know what I'm doing." –Kimi Räikkönen
auth.carQuote13: "The only ones who remember you when you finish second are your wife and your dog." –Bobby Unser
auth.carQuote14: "To achieve anything, you must be prepared to dabble on the boundary of disaster." –Stirling Moss
auth.carQuote15: "If you have the passion for racing, you always find a way." –Walter Röhrl
auth.carQuote16: "Speed has never killed anyone. Suddenly becoming stationary, that's what gets you." –Jeremy Clarkson
auth.carQuote17: "A car for every purse and purpose." –Alfred P. Sloan
auth.carQuote18: "The car has become the carapace, the protective shell, of urban man." –Marshall McLuhan
auth.carQuote19: "Everything in life is somewhere else, and you get there in a car." –E.B. White
auth.carQuote20: "Life is measured in achievement, not in years alone." –Bruce McLaren
